A separate technical-status drawer identifies what checker and deployment evidence are available; no governance controls are implied by the diagram.

proposal.title: What a Groth16 setup is tied to

proposal.readerCopy: Groth16 setup is tied to a compiled circuit. Reusing that circuit for different inputs does not by itself require a new setup. Change its constraints or supported bounds, and you may have a different circuit that needs its own Phase 2 setup.

questions: What curve, size bound, and setup implementation would define a compatible Phase 1 domain for the intended example?

proposal.limits: The K calculator is hypothetical only. Do not claim one Phase 1 covers all Cardano circuits or combine incompatible setup domains.

proposal.title: Bundling cases can change the count, within explicit bounds

What resource, review, and maintenance costs would bundling add?
Would a bound change alter the compiled constraints and require a new Phase 2 setup?
proposal.limits: Present as a design possibility, not an existing Webs capability or a solution for all future Cardano programs. No universal bounded circuit can be assumed to cover unspecified future relations.
